ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity pixels (white) account for approximately 5-8% of the visible fluke surface, primarily as linear streaks and distal clusters, while low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) constitute the remainder of the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across both lobes. Left lobe displays a series of high-contrast white linear streaks originating from the center-bottom and extending toward the trailing edge. Right lobe is predominantly uniform low-intensity with minimal white pixel clusters at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55-65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by jagged peaks and shallow valleys, particularly dense on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curve originating from the median notch and tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized at the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe and dense white clusters at the distal tips consistent with localized surface trauma or colonization.
